title: Logger saw the same craft in the area

tellings.quote: there was a there was a witness logger who had witnessed the this same craft up in that same area that they were logging.

plain: A logger working near the Allagash Waterway in Maine in the 1970s is said to have seen the same craft that a group of campers later reported in that area. Charlie Foltz, one of the men who says he saw the craft and was abducted there, tells Michels about this logger, whose name he does not give. If true, it would mean someone outside the group saw the craft too.
